extensionDescription.message: Enhances your Filmweb experience with rating filters and list randomizers.

popupSubtitle.message: Random picks from your want-to-see list

hideRatingsDescription.message: Community scores stay hidden until you rate that title on Filmweb. Your own rating panel stays visible.

subtitlesLinkDescription.message: Adds a link on film and series pages that opens OpenSubtitles.org for the current title.

countMismatch.message: Warning: loaded $1 movies, but the page shows $2.

errorNotLoggedIn.message: Open your Filmweb profile page (filmweb.pl/user/YOUR_NICK) and try again.

errorEmptyList.message: No movies found on your "Want to see" list.

errorGeneric.message: Could not draw a random movie. Refresh Filmweb and try again.

errorNoResponse.message: No response from the extension. Reload it in your browser settings.
